new-95.zh-Hans:
他挺过了第一次冲击。第二次即将到来。

创建于 Seedance 2.5。

提示词 👇

视觉风格：超电影感科幻，照片级写实CGI，夜晚黑暗未来城市，戏剧性蓝橙灯光，真实烟雾、火焰、火花、碎片，氛围雨，强有力的镜头运动，高细节环境，大片动作电影质感。

主角：一名神秘成年男性战士，健硕体型，深色短发，黑色未来装甲服带有微弱发光的蓝色能量线条，金属靴和手套。他的脸、发型、装甲设计、颜色、身体比例和武器配置必须在整个视频中保持100%一致。

0–5秒

一颗巨大的燃烧流星在夜晚坠入一条废弃的未来城市街道。镜头跟随流星从天空落下，撞击街道正中央，产生强大的冲击波。汽车被推开，窗户碎裂，烟雾和火花充满空气。

5–10秒

不改变地点，镜头靠近冒烟的流星。开裂的表面开始从内部发出蓝光，并慢慢裂开。同一个神秘装甲男子从流星内部走出，站在陨石坑中，烟雾在他周围流动。

10–15秒

在他能移动之前，几个敌对的未来战斗机器人从周围的烟雾和建筑中出现，围成一圈包围他。他慢慢环顾四周，抬起右手，蓝色能量开始在他装甲的发光线条中流动。

15–20秒

他的装甲激活，机械部件在手臂和肩膀上自然展开。他突然从刚才站立的准确位置向前冲去。他击中最近的机器人，旋转撞向另一个，并将其砸向一辆停放的车辆。其他机器人立即攻击他。

20–25秒

最大的机器人从他正后方冲来。男子在最后一刻转身，双手接住它巨大的拳头，并释放出集中的蓝色能量冲击波。机器人被向后抛飞穿过同一条街道，摧毁了几辆已经损坏的车辆和墙壁。

25–30秒

尘土慢慢散去。男子仍站在陨石坑中，喘着粗气，装甲同样受损但完好。他抬头望向天空。镜头跟随他的目光，揭示第二颗巨大的流星进入大气层，远比第一颗更大。

结束于他的脸，来自逼近流星的蓝光反射在他的装甲上。

extra-8c09596d6ca6.zh-Hans:
【作品】
美女网红的假日。“本以为准备好了，却在意起刘海”。27岁虚构日本女性在家拍摄的30秒自然手机UGC。她本人平时漂亮华丽的样子。对亲近粉丝说话的温暖距离感。

【输出】
竖屏9:16，30秒，满屏影像。左右上下不加黑边。不把竖屏视频嵌入横屏画布中央。一个人、一个房间、一台手机，一镜到底拍摄。无剪辑、无场景转换、无分屏。
时间点是同一镜头内表演的参考。不要按时间点开始新的镜头。优先自然说话、物理动作、人物同一性，而非精确秒数。

【图像角色】
@Image1 = 01_character.png。人物脸、头发、服装、体格、耳环的参考。三视图为同一人物。不把灰色背景和三分割布局带入视频。这不是起始帧。
@Image2 = 02_start_frame.png。起始帧以及房间、光线、构图、小物摆放的基准。从一开始这个人就坐在这个位置，从把伸向镜头的手收回开始。脸部从开头就可见。
两张图像的人物为同一人物。用Image1固定脸和服装，用Image2固定构图和室内布置。

【人物】
27岁，日本美妆时尚类网红。不说明工作，是假日出门去咖啡馆之前。令人印象深刻的美貌与亲和力。不重新设计参考图像中的鹅蛋脸、自然大小的杏仁眼、鼻子、柔软唇形。
有光泽的巧克力棕色、及胸中长发、脸周层次、柔软卷发、有通透感的刘海。白色圆领短袖紧身T恤、浅蓝色高腰牛仔裤、小金色圈形耳环。短浅粉色指甲。棕色精致眼妆、分明睫毛、含蓄蜜桃腮红、玫瑰米色唇。妆容全片相同。
美丽肌肤保留自然纹理、细微毛孔、眼周淡阴影、肌肤表面光泽。不刻意强调肌肤粗糙或疲劳。美在于五官和发型妆容，而不是把脸变成光滑塑料。不做极端小脸、巨大眼睛、下巴尖锐化、肌肤光泽过度增强。

【室内与拍摄】
Image2中紧凑的日本出租屋房间。白墙、浅木纹、画面右侧蕾丝窗帘、白天柔和自然光。脸部足够明亮，有自然阴影和血色。背景也能一定程度辨认的普通手机画角。没有电影般虚化或照明、过度HDR。
木桌、画面左侧椭圆桌面镜、左前方打开的米色化妆包、前方的冰拿铁和杯垫、杂志、右侧灰褐色包、椅子上的开衫保持Image2的摆放。不把房间变成豪宅、酒店、摄影棚。
相机是固定在桌上的手机。开头0.5秒放下后的轻微晃动平息，直到结束前保持固定。拍摄用的手机不出现在画面中。伸向镜头的手不遮脸。不缩放或横移。镜面朝向女性，相机看到的是背面。不添加第二个人的脸或拍摄设备的反射。

【声音与自然举止】
自然日语标准语。27岁女性发给朋友的声音距离感。声音温暖清晰，略带放松。不做推销、播音、过度撒娇声、广告台词朗读。日语与口型同步。
视线有目的地移动。说话时看镜头，确认刘海时看画面左侧的镜子，抓包时看手边。不一直盯着相机，也不一直微笑。
眨眼和呼吸频率自然。不持续无意义的手势或挑眉。允许专注而稍微安静的时间。头发从触碰处开始动，手指离开后因重力稍微回弹。转头时发梢和耳环稍延迟晃动后停稳。

【表演与台词：一镜到底30秒】
0.0–3.5秒
从Image2的姿势开始。把伸向相机的右手收回，看镜头。带着轻微成就感的自然表情。
0.5–2.5秒台词：“よし、準備できた。”（“好，准备好了。”）
不拖长结尾。之后呼一口气。

3.5–8.5秒
视线移向画面左侧的镜子。只有一束刘海让她在意。稍微改变头部角度，抬起右手。不大幅皱眉，只是小小的察觉。
4.5–7.5秒台词：“……あ、まえがみ、こっちのほうがいいかな。”（“……啊，刘海，这样是不是更好。”）

8.5–14.0秒
无言。用右手手指把一小束刘海横向整理一次。手指不穿透额头或眼睛。不全面改变刘海长度或分发线。放下手，用镜子确认。看到头发稍微回弹，嘴角极轻微放松。不加夸张反应或额外台词。

14.0–21.0秒
视线回到镜头。不在镜子和相机之间反复来回。肩膀稍微放松，露出坦率的微笑。
14.5–19.5秒台词：“でる直前になると、きゅうに気になるんだよね。”（“临出门前，就会突然在意起来呢。”）
句尾之后，短促带气息的轻笑。笑容自然产生，不固定。

21.0–25.5秒
视线落到画面右侧的包上，用左手抓住提手。把有重量的包稍微提到膝盖附近。保持同一个包，形状和材质不变。不碰到杯子、镜子或化妆包。
22.0–24.2秒台词：“今日は、カフェに行ってきます。”（“今天要去咖啡馆。”）
说台词时视线回到镜头。

25.5–30.0秒
包仍用左手拿着。右手朝镜头小幅挥一次。
26.0–27.5秒台词：“じゃ、またね。”（“那，再见啦。”）
空着的右手伸向相机。最后约0.7秒手靠近并自然虚化，画面轻微晃动时录制结束。不硬塞入站起离开。不以静止画面、黑屏或淡出结束。

【声音】
她本人的声音、呼吸、微弱房间环境音、T恤衣料摩擦声、包皮革和金属件的小声音、最后触碰手机的声音。声音与实际动作同步。无夸张ASMR、音效、BGM、他人声音、旁白、通知音。

【严格遵守】
不添加五句指定台词以外的内容。不用随意的话语填补无言时间。人物一人。脸、头发、服装、耳环到最后保持同一。手指
extra-8c09596d6ca6.en:
[Work]
A beautiful influencer's day off. "I thought I was ready, but my bangs bother me." A 30-second natural smartphone UGC filmed at home by a fictional 27-year-old Japanese woman. Her usual beautiful and glamorous appearance. A warm sense of distance as she talks to close followers.

[Output]
Vertical 9:16, 30 seconds, full-frame video. Do not add black bars on the left, right, top, or bottom. Do not embed a vertical video in the center of a horizontal canvas. One person, one room, one continuous shoot on one smartphone. No cuts, scene changes, or split screens.
Times are performance markers within the same take. Do not start a new shot at each time. Prioritize natural speech, physical movement, and character identity over precise seconds.

[Image roles]
@Image1 = 01_character.png. Reference for the person's face, hair, clothing, physique, and earrings. The three views are the same person. Do not bring the gray background or three-panel layout into the video. This is not the starting frame.
@Image2 = 02_start_frame.png. Reference for the starting frame and the room, light, composition, and prop placement. From the beginning, this person is sitting in this place, starting from pulling back the hand extended toward the camera. Her face is visible from the start.
The people in both images are the same person. Use Image1 to fix the face and outfit, and Image2 to fix the composition and indoor placement.

[Person]
27 years old, a Japanese beauty and fashion influencer. Do not explain her job; this is just before going out to a cafe on her day off. Strikingly beautiful features and approachability. Do not redesign the oval face, naturally sized almond-shaped eyes, nose, and soft lip shape from the reference image.
Glossy chocolate brown, semi-long hair down to above the chest, layers around the face, soft curls, sheer bangs. White crew-neck short-sleeve compact T-shirt, light blue high-waisted denim, small gold hoop earrings. Short pale pink nails. Brown delicate eye makeup, separated lashes, restrained peach blush, rose-beige lips. Makeup stays the same throughout.
Keep natural texture on beautiful skin, faint pores, light shadows around the eyes, and light on the skin surface. Do not deliberately emphasize skin problems or fatigue. Beauty lies in the features and hair/makeup, not in turning the face into smooth plastic. Do not use an extremely small face, huge eyes, sharpened chin, or excessive amplification of skin gloss.

[Room and filming]
The compact Japanese rental room from Image2. White walls, pale wood grain, lace curtains on the right side of the frame, soft natural daylight. The face is sufficiently bright, with natural shadows and color. The background is also somewhat discernible, with a normal smartphone field of view. No cinematic blur or lighting, no excessive HDR.
Keep the placement from Image2: wooden table, oval tabletop mirror on the left side of the frame, open unbleached makeup pouch in the left foreground, iced latte and coaster in the foreground, magazines, taupe bag on the right, cardigan on the chair. Do not make the room a mansion, hotel, or studio.
The camera is a smartphone fixed on the desk. In the first 0.5 seconds, the slight shake after setting it down settles, and it stays fixed until just before the end. The filming smartphone does not appear in the frame. Do not hide the face with the hand reaching toward the lens. Do not zoom or pan. The mirror surface faces the woman, and the camera sees its back. Do not add a second person's face or reflections of filming equipment.

[Voice and natural behavior]
Natural Japanese standard dialect. The vocal closeness of a 27-year-old woman sending a voice message to a friend. The voice is warm and clear, slightly relaxed. Do not use sales talk, announcements, excessive baby voice, or advertising line reading. Synchronize Japanese and mouth movement.
Gaze moves with purpose. When speaking to the viewer, look at the lens; when checking bangs, look at the mirror on the left side of the frame; when grabbing the bag, look at her hands. Do not stare at the camera constantly or smile constantly.
Blinking and breathing at a natural frequency. Do not continue meaningless gestures or eyebrow raises. Allow time to become focused and a little quiet. Hair moves from where it is touched and returns slightly under gravity after the fingers release. When she turns her face, the hair ends and earrings sway slightly late and settle.

[Acting and dialogue: one continuous 30 seconds]
0.0–3.5 seconds
From the pose in Image2. Pull back the right hand that was extended toward the camera and look at the lens. A natural expression with light accomplishment.
Dialogue from 0.5–2.5 seconds: "よし、準備できた。" (Okay, I'm ready.)
Do not stretch the ending long. After that, one breath.

3.5–8.5 seconds
Her gaze moves to the mirror on the left side of the frame. Just one lock of bangs bothers her. Slightly change the angle of her head and raise her right hand. Do not frown strongly; it is a small realization.
Dialogue from 4.5–7.5 seconds: "……あ、まえがみ、こっちのほうがいいかな。" (…Ah, bangs, maybe this way is better.)

8.5–14.0 seconds
Silent. With the fingertips of her right hand, she adjusts one small lock of bangs to the side once. Fingers must not pass through the forehead or eyes. Do not completely change the length of the bangs or the hair part. Lower the hand and check in the mirror. Seeing the hair return slightly, the corners of her mouth relax very slightly. Do not add exaggerated reactions or extra dialogue.

14.0–21.0 seconds
Return her gaze to the lens. Do not go back and forth between the mirror and camera many times. Her shoulders relax a little, and she gives an honest smile.
Dialogue from 14.5–19.5 seconds: "でる直前になると、きゅうに気になるんだよね。" (Right before going out, it suddenly starts bothering me.)
After the end of the sentence, a short breathy little laugh. The smile arises naturally and is not fixed.

21.0–25.5 seconds
Look down toward the bag on the right side of the frame and grab the handle with her left hand. Lift the heavy bag slightly toward her knees. Keep it as one bag, maintaining its shape and material. Do not hit the glass, mirror, or pouch.
Dialogue from 22.0–24.2 seconds: "今日は、カフェに行ってきます。" (Today, I'm going to a cafe.)
While saying the line, return her gaze to the lens.

25.5–30.0 seconds
Keep holding the bag with her left hand. With her right hand, wave once small toward the lens.
Dialogue from 26.0–27.5 seconds: "じゃ、またね。" (Well, see you.)
Extend her free right hand toward the camera. In the last about 0.7 seconds, the hand approaches and naturally blurs, and recording ends when the frame shakes slightly. Do not cram in standing up and exiting. Do not end with a still image, black screen, or fade.

[Sound]
Her own voice, breathing, faint room ambience, T-shirt fabric rustle, small sounds of the bag's leather and metal fittings, and finally the sound of touching the smartphone. Sound synchronizes with actual actions. No exaggerated ASMR, sound effects, BGM, other people's voices, narration, or notification sounds.

[Strictly adhere]
Do not add anything other than the five specified lines. Do not fill silent time with arbitrary words. One person. Face, hair, outfit, and earrings remain the same until the end. Fingers

case-393.zh-Hans:
创作一段30秒的逼真个人旅行vlog，主角为参考图中完全相同的女性。在整个视频中保持她的面部、发型、外貌、妆容、服装和项链一致。

让它感觉像一位真实的年轻女性随意记录她和朋友一起的京都秋日之旅，朋友在镜头后面拍摄。不要商业旅行广告感，不要快速蒙太奇，不要过度电影化的运镜。

保持节奏缓慢自然。每个场景应聚焦于一个简单动作。让镜头呼吸，允许自然的停顿。她应以正常人的速度行走、环顾和反应。绝不要为了在场景中塞入更多内容而加快她的动作或语速。

展现京都安静的日常瞬间：早晨乘坐当地列车，走过住宅街道，发现一家小面包店，坐在河边，逛一家小小的文具店，被小雨淋到，夜晚从自动售货机买一杯热饮。

保持对白极短且随意，带有自然停顿。比如“Cute…”、“So pretty”、“Mmm… good”、“Look…”、“This one?”、“Oh… rain”、“Nice…”和“One more stop.”。她绝不能听起来像在念剧本或赶台词。

使用真实的手持摄影机运动、细微的自动对焦、自然的曝光变化、真实的环境音、自然的皮肤质感、逼真的光线和细微的35mm胶片颗粒。有些时刻应完全没有对白。

目标很简单：让它感觉像某人在京都真实的一天中偶然拍下的真实旅行vlog，而不是AI生成的广告。
